text: Tell us about yourself and your technical background.
What inspired you to specialize in machine learning and computer vision, and what recent AI paper caught your attention?
How do you keep yourself updated with the fast-moving deep learning research and open-source tooling?
Explain your computer-vision project and the problem it solves.
Walk us through the data pipeline and image preprocessing techniques you implemented for your computer vision model.
What was the biggest technical bottleneck or latency constraint you encountered when evaluating your deep learning model, and how did you overcome it?
How did you validate your model to prevent data leakage and ensure reliable generalization on out-of-distribution real-world samples?
Why did you choose a convolutional neural network for this problem?
Explain the difference between L1 and L2 regularization and how each influences model weights during training.
How does backpropagation compute gradients through hidden layers, and why does the vanishing gradient problem occur in deep networks?
What is the difference between precision and recall, and in what computer vision applications would you prioritize recall over precision?
Describe the function of batch normalization and how it stabilizes deep neural network optimization.
What would happen to your model if the training data were highly imbalanced?
Compare Vision Transformers (ViT) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in terms of inductive bias and sample efficiency.
How do modern two-stage object detectors (like Faster R-CNN) differ from single-stage detectors (like YOLO) in localization and speed tradeoffs?
How would you handle covariate shift or domain adaptation when a computer vision model trained on daytime imagery is deployed at night or in rain?
Explain self-supervised contrastive learning frameworks like SimCLR or MoCo and the role of InfoNCE loss.
How would you handle a missed project deadline?
Describe a scenario where you had a significant technical disagreement with a colleague regarding model selection or architecture. How did you resolve it?
As a Scientist B on an applied AI team, how do you balance long-term exploratory research with short-term engineering deliverables?
